page.notes: The "ae" in "ae lætissimus" may be an æ ligature; read as printed. "Ecclesiasticam" is read from a slightly blurred word and may be misread. The footnote mark is read as "(b)", which may be "(h)" in the print. The first footnote word "Histoire" and the body of the footnote are set in a smaller, slightly blurred type and may contain small errors. The faint marks in the right margin are show-through and were left out.
